reviews.title: Beware U Sign up for free trial got Charged for monthly subscription
reviews.text:
I understand free trials are limited ( but I was charged for a monthly subscription before my free trial was even up). This was done by their design, because I canceled on Sept 4th and was  shocked to find I was charged on Sept 5th for a full month subscription. 
There is no customer service link so  Even when I went again to confirm the subscription was canceled it stated I still would be subscribed till October 5th.
Otherwise the app itself is pleasant and my granddaughter liked all the different programs. But continuing should be by my choic.
Not them charging after the fact when the trial subscription was previously cancelled.
